vault_line: Smokin' on this Popeye, this shit’s some strong cabbage
bar: Smokin' on this Popeye, this shit’s some strong cabbage
chip_form: Smokin' on this Popeye, this shit’s some strong cabbage
note_excerpt: Chief is making a reference to the fictional character Popeye, who is known to smoke his pipe and gain extreme strength from eating spinach. Spinach was also a slang for weed back in the 20’s and 30’s. Instead of a pipe, Chief is smoking weed and says it is some strong cabbage which is slang for bud
